EC1: Patients with renal impairment [AND] (serum creatinine more than twice the upper limit of normal).
EC3: Patients with sepsis [OR] or active infection.
EC4: Patients with diabetes mellitus (either primary [OR] or secondary to thalassemia).
EC5: regular consumption of medication [AND] with potential hepatotoxicity.
EC6: regular herbal medicine [OR] or antioxidant supplementation.
EC7: patients with gastrointestinal conditions preventing adsorption of oral medication.
